buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Bidders are hereby advised that submission of all requisite documents, as specified in the bid conditions are mandatory and must be uploaded along with the bid. 2. Any document submitted after the bid opening or during/after technical evaluation shall not be consider ed under any circumstances. 3. Either OEM should quote directly or OEM can authorize and give Tender Specific Authorization to its Age nt/dealer to quote on their behalf. The authorized dealer should submit valid tender specific authorization, along with the offer, failing which their offer will be summarily rejected. 4. Order will be placed on bidders who have satisfactorily supplied tendered/similar category item to India n Railways/Government organization/PSU during the last three financial years and current financial year up to the date of tender closing. The documentary evidence must include copies of CRN/CRAC (in case of Gem Case)/IC issued by TPI, Work Completion Certificate, Performance Certificate etc.

5. Specifications mentioned in BID are indicative only, bidders to supply the material strictly as per Specific ation uploaded in ATC. 6. Supply & Performance: The Hand Held Terminals (HHTs) supplied shall be new, unused, and of the la test available model conforming to the technical specifications prescribed by Railways. 7. Installation & Commissioning: i) The Testing and commissioning of the equipment shall be carried out at as advised by Railways. ii) Two (02) sets of Hand Held Terminals shall be made available at the Divisional Office at least three (03) working days prior to the commencement of bulk supply for the purpose of on - site testing, verification, an d assessment of functional suitability of the Hand Held Terminals in accordance with contractual requireme nts and CRIS specifications. iii) The supplier shall ensure that the equipment supplied for on-site testing is fully functional and meets all technical and functional requirements specified in the contract. Bulk supply and subsequent installation sh all be undertaken only after satisfactory completion of the required testing and confirmation of functional s uitability by the Railway. 8. Comprehensive Warranty & Penalty Clause: a) The HHTs shall be covered under a Comprehensive Warranty for 36 months (03 years) from the date of successful testing and commissioning of all HHTs under the contract. The date of commencement of warra nty will be determined from the final acceptance of the all the Hand held terminals, as advised by Railway Administration. The comprehensive warranty for the Hand Held Terminals shall include Touch Screen/Displ ay, Battery, Motherboard, Side Buttons, Charging Accessories, Circuits, Connectors, and all other compone nts & all hardware / software. b) The Firm shall attend to all complaints within 12 hours of lodging of the complaint and shall resolve the same within 24 hours of lodging of the complaint. In case of failure to resolve the complaint within the stip ulated period, a penalty of upto Rs. 100/- (Rupees One Hundred only) per Hand Held Terminal per day or p art thereof (excluding 24 hrs resolution time) for unsatisfactory/non-service shall be levied by the Railway. However the total penalty shall be subject to a maximum of 5% E-PBG submitted by the firm. The initial 24 hours provided to the Firm for making the equipment operational shall be excluded while calculating penal ty. The penalty shall be paid by the Vendor within 30 days from the date of advice/intimation of the penalty. I n case of failure to pay the penalty within the stipulated period, the penalty amount shall be recovered fro m the Security Deposit/Bank Guarantee / E-PBG. Non-compliance with the terms and conditions of the contract, unsatisfactory performance by the Supplier, and failure to pay the imposed penalty may also lead to forfeiture of the Security Deposit/Bank Guarantee / E-PBG, as per the terms and conditions of the contract and also liable for blacklisting of firm as per GEM t erms & condition. c) Failure reports of equipment remaining non-functional for more than 24 hours shall be advised by the C TI In-charges of the respective Mumbai Divisions on a monthly basis, in the prescribed format, to the Ticket Checking Cell, Mumbai Central, duly signed by the CTI In-charges. 9. 24×7 Technical Support: The Contractor shall provide technical support 24 hours × 7 days a week, in cluding Saturdays, Sundays and holidays, throughout the warranty period. A dedicated team of technician must be engaged to resolve the failures, on site attendance of complaints, handing and taking over of fault y / repaired equipments from Railway offices. 10. Repair and Replacement: Any defective component, part or accessory of the HHT, including Touch S creen/Display, Battery, Motherboard, Side Buttons, charging accessories, circuits, connectors and other co mponents, shall be repaired or replaced by the Contractor at no additional cost to Railways. The HHT havi ng major fault, recurring failure should be replaced with new one. 11. Spare Parts: The Firm shall maintain adequate inventory of spares and spare parts to ensure prompt and efficient service. The Firm shall carry out all necessary repairs and replacement of defective parts/co mponents free of cost to the Railway, under all circumstances, irrespective of the codal life of the equipme nt/components and environmental conditions under which the Hand Held Terminals are being operated to ensure uninterrupted and timely maintenance of HHTs. 12. Breakdown and Response Time: Complaints regarding malfunctioning HHTs shall be attended pro

mptly. The Contractor shall ensure timely restoration of the HHT to working condition and minimize downti me. Failure to do so will attract penalty as per Terms & Conditions. 13. Complaint Escalation: The Contractor shall provide a proper complaint registration and escalation m echanism, including details of the designated service personnel and escalation levels. The details of mobile number, email id, helpline number, Customer Care within the jurisdiction of Mumbai Division shall be provi ded. 14. Software/Application Support: The Contractor shall provide necessary support for the HHT operati ng system, application, firmware, drivers and other associated software required for proper functioning of the HHT during the contract/warranty period. 15. Updates and Compatibility: The Firm shall provide free patches, software upgrades, and firmware u pgrades, wherever applicable, during the entire warranty period. Such upgrades shall be provided without any additional cost to the Railway and shall ensure continued compatibility, security, functionality, and per formance of the Hand Held Terminals. 16. Battery Performance: The Contractor shall ensure proper functioning of the batteries supplied with the HHTs. Defective or degraded batteries affecting normal operation shall be replaced during the warrant y period without additional cost. 17. Service Centres: The Contractor shall also provide details of authorized service centres/service pers onnel available for attending complaints and maintenance of HHTs within the jurisdiction of Mumbai Divisio n. 18. Transportation: Transportation of defective HHTs/components to and from the authorized service ce ntre, wherever required for warranty repairs and returning back to Railways, shall be the responsibility of t he Contractor and shall not involve any additional cost to Railways. 19. Downtime: The Contractor shall maintain proper records of complaints, repairs, replacements of each HHT and shall submit such records to the Railway authorities whenever required. 20. No Additional Charges: No additional charges shall be payable by Railways for repairs, replacement of defective components, service support, software/firmware support or other activities covered under the comprehensive warranty. 21. Availability of HHTs: The Contractor shall make all reasonable efforts to ensure maximum availabilit y of HHTs and minimize disruption to Ticket Checking operations. 22. Documentation: The Contractor shall provide user manuals, technical documentation, warranty detai ls and other necessary documents related to the HHTs supplied. 23. Compliance with Railway Instructions: The Contractor shall comply with all applicable instructions , standards, security requirements and directions issued by Railway authorities from time to time regardin g the operation, maintenance and security of HHTs. 24. Confidentiality and Data Security: The Contractor shall maintain confidentiality of all Railway data, credentials, configurations and information accessed during maintenance/support activities and shall not d isclose or misuse such information. 25. Inspection and Acceptance: The HHTs shall be subject to inspection, testing and acceptance by the Railway authorities before commissioning. Any equipment not conforming to the prescribed specifications shall be rectified/replaced by the Contractor at no additional cost to Railways. Railways reserve the right t o reject any such equipments which are not to the satisfaction of railways. 26. Final Responsibility: The Contractor shall remain responsible for ensuring proper functioning and m aintenance of the HHTs throughout the applicable warranty/contract period in accordance with the terms a nd conditions of the contract. 27. Payment : CRAC shall be generated by the consignee gazetted officer and 100% of the value of contr act shall be paid subject to submission of the following documents: I) RITES inspection certificate along with technical compliance certificate & Guarantee /Warranty certificate of OEM duly certified by RITES. II) Successful receipt of all machines at divisions and submission of successful FINAL COMMISSIONING CER TIFICATE of all HHT.

III) Self certificate that "power on test" of all the machines is done successfully by the supplier. IV) 5 % E- PBG towards warranty security by the supplier. V ) Submission of Complaint Escalation matrix & Service Centre details. 28. Place of Delivery: The Hand Held Terminals shall be delivered to the Ticket Checking Cell, Divisional Railway Manager’s Office, Commercial Department, Ground Floor, Mumbai Central, Mumbai – 400 008. . 2.
